title: Actress Hayden Panettiere Dies at 36
content: Actress Hayden Panettiere died at 36 on Sunday, her family announced in a statement to ABC News. The investigation into her death is ongoing, but no foul play is suspected. The actress voiced Kairi in Square Enix 's Kingdom Hearts franchise from the first game to Birth by Sleep , and also voiced Xion in Kingdom Hearts…
author: ANN

title: Kakao Entertainment to Merge 3 Story Content Subsidiaries
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on August 14 that it will merge three of its story content subsidiaries — Samyang C&C, Intime, and Pilyeon Management — as part of efforts to strengthen its intellectual property business.
author: ANN

title: 86 Anime Returns to Crunchyroll After Being Delisted
content: Crunchyroll added the television anime of Asato Asato 's 86 light novel series last Friday. The series was previously available on the service, but was removed sometime between April 7 and May 23 earlier this year according to the Internet Archive.
author: ANN

title: HarperCollins to Launch Kazé Manga Imprint for U.S. Market
content: KAZÉ will have an industry panel at Anime NYC on Saturday, August 22. The panel will feature Josh Sippie and Emilia Sowersby, editors at KAZÉ US. The panel description states it will reveal a sneak peek of titles coming in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Disney Announces 'Cursed Love' Romantasy Webtoon Initiative
content: Disney Publishing announced Disney Cursed Love, a new romantasy initiative inspired by Disney's classic love stories, at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event 2026 on August 14. title: Go Forward Anime's 2 Seasons Stream on SkySet TV Starting on August 18
content: Licensing and dubbing studio SkySet Entertainment announced on Saturday it will stream the Go Forward. ( Massugu ni Ikō ) television anime and its sequel series Massugu ni Ikō: Melon Pan-hen on August 18, which marks the 23rd anniversary since the anime first debuted on August 18, 2003.

title: Star Detective Precure! Anime Unveils New Ending Theme, Character Visuals (Contains Spoilers)
content: The staff for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise, revealed on Sunday the new ending theme song and new cast visuals. Spoiler warning: The announced characters and visuals as well as the below video may contain spoilers for Star Detective Precure!

title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless... Manga's 1st Part Ends, 2nd Part Debuts in Early 2027
content: Shueisha 's Young Jump + platform published the final chapter of the first part of Musshu 's manga adaptation of Teren Mikami 's There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless... ( Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Naijan, Muri Muri! Muri Janakatta!? or WATANARE ) yuri romantic comedy novel series on July 31.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailer Previews DLC Character Duck King
content: SNK began streaming English and Japanese trailers for the Fatal Fury City of the Wolves fighting game to preview the DLC character Duck King on Sunday. The game will add Duck King on August 27.
author: ANN
